chapter: Young players, schools and studio work
title: Melodic continuity missing in modern jazz
summary: Maxwell criticizes young players for lacking melodic continuity, unlike Armstrong, Lester Young, Clifford Brown and Coltrane.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
